note: The anaerobic ammonium oxidiser, the "lithotroph missing from nature", is identified as a new autotrophic planctomycete that divides only once every two weeks; DOI matches. Abstract supports the 1999 identification of the anammox organism. The -357 kJ per mol figure is not in the abstract, and the Broda 1977 prediction cited beside it was not checked.
